task: Identify transient onset candidates on additional-station vertical waveforms at native sample rate, with honest channel-quality and phase uncertainty
cases: The four already-seen stage4 quality cases, all remain development diagnostics
algorithm: linear detrend; cosine taper 2%; causal 4-corner bandpass; classic STA/LTA 0.5s/10s; on 3.5 off 1.0
reference: PNW current metadata P-arrival sample / 100 + trace_start_time; evaluation only, never passed to agent or algorithm
evaluation: First eligible onset residual and nearest eligible onset residual to reference; all onsets retained. Within 2 seconds is diagnostic correspondence, not source classification or phase validation
quality_requirement: Vertical-only onset detection needs valid Z, not all three components; a missing horizontal channel must not block a valid Z calculation
